news.title: Universities of Wisconsin to host public listening sessions for presidential search
news.summary_en: UW–Madison will serves as a listening session site on Wednesday, June 10. Students, faculty, staff and community members are invited to attend in personal or virtually.

news.title: The two Owens
news.summary_en: The death of a six-year-old inspired a UW–Madison researcher to investigate a rare brain cancer.

news.title: Research at UW–Madison improves care for dogs undergoing surgeries
news.summary_en: A 2023 study led to an anesthesia method to keep dogs comfortable and healthy when undergoing many surgical procedures necessary for their care.

news.title: Universities of Wisconsin Board of Regents approves modest tuition increase
news.summary_en: The 2 percent increase is below the current inflation rate and is designed to help universities address rising operating costs while continuing to maintain affordability

news.title: Zika infections can cause significant developmental problems
news.summary_en: Even babies born without the virus’s notable physical symptoms may experience sensory, attachment and anxiety issues, according to a new study.
